texts.name: Karrul
texts.biography: Karrul is the lieutenant of Tark, king of the Nix. He was sent to the cove to represent him there and lead the Nix during battles.

specialty.name: Nix
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Nix and Nix Warriors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
